Interface ShortIndexedContainer

All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<ShortCursor>, RandomAccess, ShortCollection, ShortContainer
All Known Implementing Classes:
ShortArrayList, ShortStack
@Generated(date="2026-09-20T20:45:46+0200", value="KTypeIndexedContainer.java") public interface ShortIndexedContainer extends ShortCollection, RandomAccess
An indexed container provides random access to elements based on an index. Indexes are zero-based.
